posts:
Uncovering hidden architects behind France's fiery streets or spinning a grand red-green conspiracy?
Evidence: Foreign Funding, Activist Coalitions, Domestic Unrest
#Aletheia #France #Geopolitics 🌐

Reports claim France's destructive riots aren't student-led uprisings but an engineered plot by a red-green alliance of 54 communist and Islamist extremist groups.
Stated Judgement: (+0.50, +0.00) — Lesser Good

While radical groups join protests, reducing mass socioeconomic unrest to a foreign-funded Islamist-communist conspiracy scapegoats minorities and erases domestic policy failures.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.65, -0.75) — Greater Evil

Verdict: FAIL — Awakening into Destruction.
Framing indigenous socioeconomic anger purely as foreign-backed subversion misdirects public accountability.

Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 14.2, z: 2)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- The Federalist Reporting: FAIL (-0.8, -0.9) — Exaggerates external plots.
- Foreign Funding Narrative: COND (-0.5, -0.6) — Mixes real links with panic.
Amidst French demonstrations over living costs and policy, conservative media outlets highlighted connections between local agitators and international leftist/activist networks.

The Poison:
Weaponizing real international activist ties to paint all domestic dissent as an imported alien invasion, destroying nuance and fueling xenophobic panic.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
This report commits a Metaphysical Plane Error, substituting complex domestic economic grievances with an external ideological bogeyman.

Social Physics Analysis:
Actors run a Smart Selfish Maneuver, taking real activist overlaps and weaving a grand conspiracy pretext to project blame onto outsiders and suppress domestic reform.

The Trajectory: The Path of Awakening into Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated threat-exposing and ground-level xenophobic scapegoating, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception.

The Unavoidable Truth: Global activist networks do network and support allied protests across borders.

The Unavoidable Lie: Domestic uprisings are merely puppet shows pulled by foreign communist wires.

Alethekanon:
Exaggerating real transnational solidarity into an existential foreign invasion replaces structural economic accountability with paranoid distraction.

Awwthekanon:
When people take to the streets in pain over rising costs, reducing their desperate cries to a foreign conspiracy denies their very humanity and suffering.

Brothekanon:
Come on, man. Are some radicals stirring the pot? Sure. But blaming every street protest on some shadowy commie-Islamist alliance is pure sci-fi panic.

Spirithekanon:
"A wicked person listens to malicious speech; a liar pays attention to a destructive tongue." Proverbs 17:4 PASS
Fabricating foreign bogeymen blinds societies to their own internal fractures.

Report: A Network Of Communists And Muslims Is Fueling France’s Riots

The rioters burning and pillaging cities across France are not led primarily by disgruntled students, as corporate media claim, but rather by a red-green alliance of communist activists and Muslim agitators, a recent investigation found. Actual Article Body:
The rioters burning and pillaging cities across France are not led primarily by disgruntled students, as corporate media claim, but rather by a red-green alliance of communist activists and Muslim agitators, a recent investigation found.

The network is made up of 54 organizations representing communism, revolutionary socialism, unions, climate change activism, Muslim student and pro-Palestinian groups, as well as corporate media, according to Fox News’ Asra Nomani. Only 16 of the 54 are actually student groups.

The far-left groups, including Gilets Jaunes (“Yellow Vests”) and French socialist party La France Insoumise (LFI, “France Unbowed”), reportedly capitalized on student discontent to stoke riots and agitation against capitalism and government.

Communist student groups identified by Fox News include La Jeunesse, Le Poing Levé (“The Raised Fist”), and Union de la Jeunesse Communiste (“Communist Youth Union”), but these are far outnumbered by the adult-led “revolutionary” communist and socialist groups that have driven the destructive riots.

Communist activist Vijay Prashad asserted a link between France’s riots and similar worldwide unrest, including in New Delhi, India, and Buenos Aires, Argentina. “Let fury have the hour, anger can be power,” Prashad posted to social media, quoting English punk band The Clash. Prashad is the executive director of Tricontinental Ltd. — an organization funded by fellow communist and tech millionaire Neville Roy Singham, an American currently residing in Shanghai, China.

Muslim and pro-Palestine organizations participating in the unrest and destruction include Union juive française pour la paix (“French Jewish Union for Peace”) and Urgence Palestine (“Palestine Emergency”).

This is what we import. And they are destroying us. pic.twitter.com/o03MW4KJ57

Amnesty International France is also behind the riots, along with “antiracism” group SOS Racisme, Ligue des droits de l’Homme (“Human Rights League”), Mouvement contre le racisme et pour l’amitié entre les peuples (“Movement Against Racism and for Friendship Between Peoples”), Les Soulèvements de la Terre (“Earth Uprisings”), and many other self-proclaimed human rights and environmental activist groups.

The Islamo-Communist-led violence has destroyed priceless historic buildings and art, desecrated statues, including that of Saint Joan of Arc, France’s patron saint, and brought untold losses from rampant looting of businesses.

Palestinianism is a Trojan horse promoted and pushed by the enemies of the West.📸 Joan of Arc statue in Toulouse. pic.twitter.com/D5Byf451hs

According to Fox News, 28 communist and socialist organizations are pushing young people to agitate in 12 European countries with walkouts, blockades, and occupations, using the slogan “fight for our future, not their wars.” The outlet said that the French unrest has benefitted from groups linked to Singham, including paid-protester group CodePink, founded by Singham’s wife, Jodie Evans, and a New York-based media organization called BreakThrough News.

BreakThrough News shared videos of the chaos, fires, and the hoisting of Palestinian flags across numerous cities on social media, while featuring LFI politicians.

Evans told BreakThrough News that the campaign across the West will come to Washington, D.C., in November in opposition to military spending, telling Americans to “look at France, Spain and India” as inspiration for what to do in D.C.

Riot organizers are already planning to unleash another outbreak of unrest on Nov. 20 in Europe, with several United Kingdom-based groups endorsing agitation, including Counterfire, the British Socialist Party, Socialist Students, and Stop the War Coalition.
